answer: A sybil attacker must fund thousands of independent bonds, so forging identities costs linearly more than honest participation. A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a bond to register, and every attestation it signs is backed by that bond. Peers verify bonds against the shared atlas of registered agents, while a quill-signed ledger records each epoch's attestations, and slashed bonds are recorded as timber burned, making fake identities unprofitable. In practice, sa0004 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
